slides.head:
ElevenLabs is in early talks to raise
at a $33 billion valuation.
Bloomberg reported the talks.
slides.body: On November 25, Bloomberg reported the talks, citing people familiar with the matter. The round would start in the first quarter of 2027. ElevenLabs declined to comment.

slides.head: Up 50% since September.
slides.body: $33 billion is 50% above the $22 billion valuation set by a $300 million employee tender offer in September. It is 10 times the $3.3 billion of January 2025.

slides.head: Six times Suno.
slides.body: AI music rival Suno reached a $5.4 billion valuation in June. ElevenLabs competes with it through ElevenMusic, launched in August 2025.

slides.head: $700 million a year.
slides.body: One person told Bloomberg that ElevenLabs' annual recurring revenue has reached $700 million, up from $600 million in September.

slides.head: AI audio is now a core tool.
slides.body: Investors are pricing AI voice and music as production tools, not experiments. Learn them now, and watch which ones license the music they train on.
